subject: pe
title: Hydration: Strategies
welcome_lead: Drink before, during and after — and tailor for the weather.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: hydration before/during/after sport, heat.
final_note: A drinks bottle is part of your kit.

concepts.def: Right level of fluid in the body.

walkthroughs.body_html: Drink water steadily during the day. Top up 150-300 ml just before sport.
Take small sips every 15-20 minutes. In heat, sweat more — drink more, and consider sports drinks if exercising hard for over an hour.
After exercise, drink to replace losses. Pale yellow urine colour is a sign you're back to normal.
